crossRefs.note: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.
Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard.…

translations.web: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
translations.bsb: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; He has weighed me down with chains.
translations.kjv: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
translations.asv: He hath walled me about, that I cannot go forth; he hath made my chain heavy.
